asked.item: Can background music fade out over the last 3 seconds via the API
Whether the transition fade option applies to music instead of clips

verdict.reason: The help pages list no fade-out or fade-duration setting for musicConfig (only enabled, url, and volume), and the transition fade (S28-S29) applies to transitions, not to the music track, so the sentences answer a neighboring question rather than whether the music can fade out.
